definitionOfDone.reasoning: 7 of 8 DoD conditions are verifiably met: (1) All 9 component files exist with correct filenames in components/. (2) app/page.tsx fully rewritten with 9-component composition. (3) npm run build cannot be verified without execution. (4) npm run lint cannot be verified without execution. (5) 65 of 68 ACs are fully met; AC-30 and AC-62 are partial (stroke-current vs stroke='currentColor' attribute; footer logo color assumption); AC-68 is unverifiable without browser rendering. (6) No tags, no 'use client', no 'dark:' variants confirmed absent. (7) All 3 anchor IDs present on section wrappers. (8) All external links have target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'. The definition states 'there is no partial done state' and requires build pass (AC-01, AC-02) plus all 68 ACs verifiable as true. Since AC-01, AC-02, and AC-68 are unverifiable without runtime execution, and AC-30 has a minor deviation (SVG attribute vs Tailwind class), the DoD cannot be declared fully met from static analysis alone. The codebase is functionally complete and very likely to pass a build, but runtime verification is required.
